verdict.rationale: Slack exposes a Web API and MCP server with per-item operations (send message, upload file, manage lists) that a developer or AI agent could script into loops for bulk actions, and Workflow Builder adds no-code automation, but there is no documented native batch/bulk endpoint, and community evidence shows Slack restricts bulk data export (corporate approval required) and limits history on free plans, undercutting true bulk operation support.
